## Description

Uses Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) trained on infinite-dimensional function spaces governed by Heath-Jarrow-Morton (HJM) interest rate term structure PDEs to forecast multi-tenor yield curve evolution.

## Where it may fit

Central bank interest rate shocks, yield curve twist/steepening events, fixed income relative value arbitrage.

## Vehicles

Fixed income arbitrage funds, global macro hedge funds, interest rate derivatives desks.

## Required data

Multi-tenor sovereign bond yields, interest rate swap curves, macroeconomic inflation expectations.

## Caveats

Mesh-independent FNO training requires high-resolution historical yield curve surface data.
